wick.options.title: Wick
wick.options.enabled.tooltip: Turns every dynamic light off at once. The Turn Dynamic Lights On/Off key flips this in game.
wick.options.keys.tooltip: Set a key to turn dynamic lights on and off without opening this screen.
wick.options.held_items.tooltip: Torches, lanterns, glowstone, lava buckets and any other glowing item light up the area around whoever holds it, in either hand, on their head, or in a Curios or Trinkets accessory slot. Endermen carrying a glowing block count too.
wick.options.others.tooltip: Lets other players and mobs light their surroundings with what they hold. Turn off to keep only your own light, which helps on crowded servers.
wick.options.dropped_items.tooltip: A torch on the ground, in an item frame, or shown by an item or block display keeps shining.
wick.options.burning.tooltip: Anything on fire lights its surroundings: mobs, players and flaming arrows.
wick.options.glowing_mobs.tooltip: Blazes, magma cubes, glow squid, fireballs, wither skulls, spectral arrows, lit TNT, lightning, end crystals, creepers about to blow, furnace minecarts with fuel and falling glowing blocks. Glowing mobs from other mods light up too.
wick.options.water_sensitive.tooltip: Torches, campfires, lava buckets and blaze items go dark underwater. Lanterns, glowstone and sea lanterns keep shining.
wick.options.walls.tooltip: Light stops at solid blocks, so a torch does not shine through a wall into the next room or a cave below, but it still finds its way around corners and through doorways, a little dimmer for the longer way. Glass, leaves, slabs and doors let it through. Turn off for the cheaper glow that passes through everything.
wick.options.enchanted_glow.tooltip: Enchanted weapons, tools, armor and books give off a faint glow, held, worn or dropped, and so does anything else with the enchantment shimmer. Off by default.
wick.options.updates.tooltip: How often lights follow their source. Slower updates rebuild fewer chunks, which helps on weaker computers.
wick.options.range.tooltip: Light sources further away than this stay dark.
wick.options.max_sources.tooltip: The most dynamic lights at once. The nearest ones win.
wick.options.reset.tooltip: Puts every option on this screen back to its default. Custom item light levels in wick.json are kept.
